description:
QTL and marker-trait associations read from the tables of open-access pulse and legume papers (PubMed Central full
text, mostly 2015 onwards). Adds QTL tables for crops without a QTL database here (pea, lentil, chickpea, lupin, faba bean) and more for soybean and common bean. Search by trait words (matched in the table's trait column and caption),
chromosome ('Ca4', 'LG3', 'Gm05', 'chr2' (prefix as the paper writes it)), region ('Ca4:10-12Mb' on the assembly the paper used); species words ('chickpea', 'Cicer', 'lentil', 'soybean') from the paper title or table caption. Each row gives the
trait, QTL name, marker, chromosome, the position as reported (assembly as stated in the paper), cM, LOD, p, PVE,
the table caption and the paper with its licence. Chromosome names keep the paper's prefix (Ca, Gm, Pv, Vu, LG, chr); positions are on whatever assembly or map the paper used. Tables were parsed automatically: check a
surprising row in the paper.
name: paper_qtl
